Logo Design – IBU HILMI

A portfolio logo identity study for a small home-style food business.

IBU HILMI — Logo Identity Study

Brand Snapshot

FieldDirection
Brand nameIBU HILMI — exact spelling preserved
Brand typeSmall food business, everyday home-style food (working assumption)
Working categoryIndonesian home-cooked meals / masakan rumahan — unconfirmed
Primary audienceNearby residents, workers, students, families, takeaway customers
PositioningA simple, familiar, approachable place for comforting everyday meals
Brand promiseFood that feels familiar, welcoming, and dependable
Logo architecturePictorial mark + wordmark → combination mark; optional compact stamp / badge
StyleMinimalist, flat, warm, friendly, easy to reproduce

Working assumption only: everyday Indonesian home-style meals. Menu, location and service format are unconfirmed.

Brand Strategy

Central idea

The warmth of a home meal, expressed with simplicity.

01  Warm

Welcoming and familiar.

02  Honest

Simple, approachable, trustworthy.

03  Comforting

Evokes everyday meals and a feeling of home.

Brand promise

Food that feels familiar, welcoming, and dependable.

Design principles

  • • The name IBU HILMI stays the most important verbal element
  • • Sturdy shapes — no fine strokes that vanish on stickers or stamps
  • • Not luxury, not trendy fusion, not a chain
  • • Never depict Ibu Hilmi’s real appearance; no invented dish or biography

Shared: minimalist · flat · scalable · monochrome-first

Logo Architecture

TypeVerdictReason
WordmarkRoute CPossible, but needs a food cue to read as food.
LettermarkHidden onlyH appears subtly in steam negative space.
PictorialPRIMARYA bowl is instantly food and easy to reproduce.
AbstractRejectedFood must read at first glance.
MascotSecondaryNot pursued; avoids inventing a character.
CombinationPRIMARY LOCKUPBowl + name; both usable alone.
EmblemOptionalStamp adaptation only, not the primary logo.

The warmth of a home meal, expressed with simplicity.
The symbol is built to work alone (avatar / icon / stamp); the wordmark must work alone on signage and documents.

Selected Concept

IBU HILMI

Selected: A — Steam H

A and B tie on score (33 each). A is chosen on judgement: the bowl signals food, the steam signals warmth, and the H ties it to Hilmi — B is a generic ring. Risk to test: steam stems thin at 16 px and on stamps. C depends on the wordmark alone.

Next: build on a modular grid, correct optically, test small sizes, then apply colour only after the monochrome version is approved.
